searchConsole.source: Supplied Google Search Console workbook ending 2026-08-01
searchConsole.rule: Null means unmeasured, not zero. Record the first complete post-release 28-day page and query export before declaring a search result.

publication.incident: BoatNerd retired the passage/getPassageData endpoint; the edition still published but all seven live passage calls failed.

product: The landing title and first answer match Great Lakes shipping news today intent.
The live card links directly to the dated issue while retaining a crawlable fallback.
Archive and RSS links are visible without opening a menu.
Current headlines appear on six relevant owned distribution pages, with one contextual birding link.
No public audience roadmap, ad sales page, or sponsor solicitation is published.
publication: At least five of seven AIS passage sources pass before distribution.
At least three NOAA water-level stations and three NWS lake forecasts pass.
Port reports and vessel news older than 48 hours cannot enter current-news context.
Multiple morning attempts cannot create a duplicate issue or WordPress draft.
A failed source-health check produces a visible failed workflow instead of a silent success.

first28Days.searchMeasurement: Establish the first complete landing-page and non-brand query baseline; do not infer zero from absent rows.

day90.note: Targets are decision gates, not forecasts or guarantees.

measurement.searchWindow: Compare complete 28-day Search Console windows only.
measurement.reliabilityWindow: Record every scheduled date in America/Detroit, issue generation time, public URL, and source-health counts.
measurement.engagementDenominator: Pageviews across the six widget-bearing distribution pages.
stopConditions: A duplicate dated issue or duplicate FVF draft is created.
The latest card points to the wrong date.
A stale vessel movement is framed as current news.
A widget materially regresses Core Web Vitals or blocks a live tool.
